polar.square.$comment: Speed fraction by angle off the wind: index i is i * stepDeg, 0 = head to wind, 180 = running. Square rig peaks on a broad reach. Tuned for play over strict realism (PRD: fun wins): no drive inside ~33 deg, and the best upwind course (about 55 deg off) makes good ~0.37 of top speed, so beating east against the trades is slow but a real option.
